summary.text: Sandy Donatucci, a Republican from Buford, represents District 105 in the Georgia House of Representatives and was first elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, Donatucci is a military spouse who graduated from Indiana University of Pennsylvania, worked for AAFES while living in Aviano, Italy with her husband, who served in the U.S. Army, and has worked in sales for more than 30 years, including as a Realtor.
The website says she previously served on the Gwinnett County Planning Commission and has lived in Gwinnett County for 23 years.

sources.title: Rep. Sandy Donatucci Sworn in, Receives Committee Assignments for the 2025-2026 Legislative Term
